parameters.content:
## Enable Banking Token Renewal (spec 005 section 4.2.1)
Network calls are HTTP Request nodes only (the Code sandbox forbids network modules like node:https; Code nodes may require node:crypto and fs) - the ServiceAccount token is read per execution and injected as an Authorization header expression.
- Daily: read both Secrets; valid_until within 3 days or token Secret missing -> Slack nudge in #workflows
- Form: POST /auth -> Form Ending redirect to the bank consent
- Bank redirect lands on /webhook/enablebanking-consent?code=... -> POST /sessions -> upsert finance-enablebanking-token -> Slack confirm
Whitelist exactly https://automation-n8n.homelab.alvsanand.com/webhook/enablebanking-consent on the application.

nodes.name: Daily Check
nodes.notes: Before the 06:00 finance DAG so a renewal decided today is in place by ingest time.

nodes.name: Get Stable Secret
nodes.notes: kubernetes.default.svc is validated by the pod's CA; allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to this in-cluster endpoint

nodes.name: Get Token Secret
nodes.notes: kubernetes.default.svc is validated by the pod's CA; allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to this in-cluster endpoint; the 404 is an expected state the downstream IF branches on

nodes.name: Healthy, No Action
nodes.notes: Fires on healthy days; keeps the false branch explicit.
